dict.string: T.A.R.S. reads your calendar events to include in briefings and schedule management.
T.A.R.S. syncs your contacts for email enrichment and communication drafting.
T.A.R.S. reads your health data (sleep, steps, workouts, heart rate, exercise minutes) to include in your daily briefings and health insights.
T.A.R.S. needs microphone access for voice input.
T.A.R.S. uses speech recognition for voice input and commands.
